criteria.requirement: Every required BaseException from the yielded user block restores the exact original bytes/permissions, closes reader and writer, removes the temporary backup and propagates the same original object. Preserve success, ordinary errors, text/binary and custom extension behavior, signatures and original native tests. Do not implement only a finite tuple of common exceptions or broaden to unrelated crash/setup guarantees.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests in the authorized file that fail on the pinned original and pass after the repair; cite the actual implementation and tests. Preserve all original tests and controls.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests within the authorized test paths that fail on the pinned original and pass with the change. Preserve the frozen original tests, test controls, and compatibility behavior; cite actual delivered test files. Controller-owned verification is independent evidence and does not replace delivered public tests.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
